title: Ethereal Green Oracle
description: A towering green-skinned female figure with cracked porcelain-like skin and glowing purple eyes stands against a dark cosmic sky. Her body is composed of dripping purple and green organic forms, cityscapes on her shoulders, a seashell in her left hand, and an ornate glowing green window in her chest revealing tiny purple figures within.
prompt: A surreal towering female figure with green cracked porcelain skin and glowing purple eyes, wearing an elaborate crown of flowers and dripping organic matter. Her body merges with purple and green swirling forms and cityscapes on her shoulders. She holds a large ornate seashell in one hand while an illuminated gothic window in her chest reveals tiny purple figures inside. Dramatic beams of light from above, turbulent ocean waves and starry night sky in the background, intricate dripping textures and swirling patterns throughout, in a dark fantasy style.
